preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 50,000.
For each test case, the number of nodes N and the number of trees K must satisfy 1 <= K <= N <= 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each node value A_i must be a non-negative integer up to 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct nodes within the range of 1 to N.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum possible value of the bitwise AND of the XORs of the node values in each of the K trees.
